استوزرن (form X)
# اِسْتَوْزَرْنَ (istawzarna) /is.taw.zar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَوْزَرَ (istawzara)
# اُسْتُوزِرْنَ (ustūzirna) /us.tuː.zir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَوْزَرَ (istawzara)
# اِسْتَوْزِرْنَ (istawzirna) /is.taw.zir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَوْزَرَ (istawzara)
